thread:
jess_sales: Quick sync — ACME FinServ wants a 3-week POC. Key asks: data residency (EU), SOC2 controls, and a performance target: 95th p50+p95 latency under 150ms for churn prediction model. They also want pricing for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private. Can we outline constraints and an opinion on deployment mode?
andre_eng: short answer: Dedicated if they need predictable throughput + SLA; Private only if they insist on full VPC/on-prem and strict tenancy. Hosted might be fine for a sandbox but prob not for regulated finserv.
sam_soleng: Agree w/andre. Also need to nail the eval plan — what prompts/datasets we'll use and how we measure quality regression vs baseline. Suggest: 1) latency SLO, 2) token-unit cost cap, 3) end-to-end correctness (AUC lift or precision at K).
jess_sales: They asked for pricing delta. tyler_pricing, can you ballpark a POC quote for 3 weeks: Hosted (burst), Dedicated (small reserved), Private (VPC)? Include support/rollout hours.
tyler_pricing: Roughs: Hosted POC: $0 setup, usage billed at dev rates — estimate $6k for expected tokens + 10h SE support. Dedicated POC (1 GPU pool reserved 3 weeks): setup + reserved min $18k + $4k support. Private (VPC + onboarding + ent. support): $45k minimum incl. network setup + 10k support. I'll put formal numbers in email.
maria_secu: Security checklist notes: for Hosted POC we need to confirm data handling (are they sending PHI?), retention policy, and optional tokenization. For Dedicated we can offer dedicated tenancy but still a managed control plane — KMS integration available. For Private we can do customer-managed KMS/HSM and audit log export.
jess_sales: They will send a security questionnaire. Any red flags we should pre-answer?
maria_secu: Pre-answer items: 1) SOC2 and ISO certs we hold (provide links), 2) data-at-rest encryption (AES-256), 3) KMS options (managed or customer), 4) VPC peering/privatelink available for Dedicated and Private, 5) incident response timelines. If they want on-prem air-gapped, that becomes >Private discussion.
and re_eng: On infra tradeoffs: performance depends on model size + quantization. For 8k context churn prompts, a 7B quantized to int8 on A100-like gives great latency. If they need 2k token responses at high concurrency, Dedicated autoscaling + continuous batching necessary. For POC we can constrain concurrency to replicate production tail.
sam_soleng: Eval plan draft: - Dataset: 2k anonymized records + 200 holdout prompts - Metrics: latency (p50/p95), token cost, precision@10, false-positive rate - Regression harness: run nightly diff vs baseline and fail POC if precision drop > 3%
jess_sales: Timeline: Week 0: contract + NDA + questionnaire. Week 1: infra setup + seed data + smoke tests. Week 2: run evals + optimization (batching/quantization). Week 3: polish dashboards, handoff. Is that realistic?
tyler_pricing: timeline looks fine. Note: Dedicated setup ~48-72h if infra capacity is available. Private may take 2-4 weeks for network & KMS integration.
maria_secu: Also add: for EU residency require region eu-west-1 or eu-central-1. For Hosted we can pin region but need to confirm data ingress/egress. For Dedicated we can provision in EU region. Private — customer network determines residency.
and re_eng: Quick config snippet we can share to customer for Dedicated POC (example minimal policy):
```
# ded-poc config
region: eu-central-1
instance_pool: reserved-gpu-small
autoscale: min=1,max=3
kms: managed|customer
network: privatelink-enabled
```
jess_sales: Perfect. Also ACME asked if we can cap token spend during POC. Can we do that?
tyler_pricing: Yes — we can set quotas on the account: e.g., hard cap $X for duration. Billing team approves but standard. I'll include quota option in the quote.
infra-bot: deployment: reserved-gpu-small pool available in eu-central-1, estimated spin-up 36h.
sam_soleng: Next steps for us: 1) jess to send questionnaire + data sample 2) tyler to send formal quote with quota options 3) maria to draft security pre-answers 4) andre to prepare dev sandbox and config snippet 5) sam to produce eval harness template.
jess_sales: I'll queue these today and update ACME. Thanks team :thumbsup:
